prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: low-speed head-on collision. Injury: whiplash. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1185; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter concerns the injuries sustained by our client, [CLIENT_NAME], in a motor vehicle collision that occurred on [LOSS_DATE]. Our client was lawfully operating a vehicle when another vehicle crossed into the client's lane and struck it head-on. Although the impact occurred at a low rate of speed, the force transmitted through the vehicle was sufficient to cause a significant whiplash injury to the client's neck and upper back.

Following the collision, our client sought prompt medical evaluation and has since undergone a course of treatment that includes physical therapy and ongoing chiropractic care. Our client continues to experience neck stiffness, headaches, and limited range of motion, which have interfered with work duties and daily activities. Medical records documenting diagnosis, treatment, and associated charges are enclosed for your review.

The available evidence shows that your insured bears responsibility for this collision. Liability should not be in dispute, and we ask that your company evaluate this claim in good faith.

Our client is prepared to resolve this matter without litigation. We therefore demand payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to settle all claims arising from this accident. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If it is not accepted within that time, we will file suit without further notice.
